measurementLimits: Observational local Release results; no release threshold, energy or UI claim. Census CPU percentages are ps samples, not isolation proof. Whole-process RSS includes harness and references. Pair 1 acquired around compilation; pairs 2 and 3 repeated in reverse order before the full verification build. The supplementary Core fallback test was added after the initial baseline; all timed harness source files are identical. All six betweenness runs observed external compiler activity; the short candidate runs have only two census snapshots each. Parenthesized process names are included conservatively, even if stale or defunct; ps percentages do not establish instantaneous CPU contention. Overflow fallback performance is not benchmarked.
